rows.text_en: Ministry of Science and ICT ( Research Industry Promotion Division ), 044-202-4731

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「연구산업진흥법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Research Industry Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(전문연구사업자의 신고 등) ① 「연구산업진흥법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제6조제1항에 따라 전문연구사업자로 신고를 하려는 연구사업자는 별지 제1호서식의 전문연구사업자 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Reporting, etc. by Specialized Research Business Operators) ① A research business operator who intends to report as a specialized research business operator pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Research Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit the specialized research business operator report form in Annex No. 1, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Science and ICT.
1. Overview of the Specialized Research Business Operator Project ( Form No. 2)

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제3호서식의 전문연구사업자의 조직 및 전문인력 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Organization and Professional Personnel of Specialized Research Project Operators ( Form No. 3)

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제4호서식의 전문연구사업자 연구기자재 명세서[전문연구사업자의 신고업종 분야가 「연구산업진흥법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제1호가목의 연구산업(이하 “주문연구산업”이라 한다)인 경우만 해당한다]
rows.text_en: 3. Specification of Research Equipment for Specialized Research Business Operators in Form No. 4 [Applicable only if the reported business sector of the specialized research business operator is the customer research industry under Article 2, Subparagraph 1, Item (a) of the Research Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)]
4. Specialized Research Business Operator Project Specification ( Form No. 5)

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 영 제5조에 따른 요건을 갖추었음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 5. Other documents proving that the requirements under Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree have been met

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제7조제4항에 따른 전문연구사업자 신고증은 별지 제6호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of registration for specialized research business operators pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as shown in Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제8조제2항에 따른 전문연구사업자 변경신고서는 별지 제7호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The notification of change of specialized research business operator pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제9조제1항에 따른 전문연구사업자 갱신신고서는 별지 제8호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ④ The specialized research business operator renewal report pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 8 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제3조(연구장비성능평가의 절차 등) ① 영 제10조제1항에 따라 연구장비성능평가를 신청하려는 연구사업자는 별지 제9호서식의 연구장비성능평가 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 법 제8조제3항에 따라 지정된 평가기관(이하 “평가기관”이라 한다)에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Procedures for Research Equipment Performance Evaluation, etc.) ① A research business operator who intends to apply for research equipment performance evaluation pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the application for research equipment performance evaluation in Form No. 9 of the Appendix, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to an evaluation institution designated pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “evaluation institution”).
1. Detailed specifications of research equipment
2. Research Equipment Instruction Manual
3. Proposal for Research Equipment Performance Evaluation Items

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 평가기관이 연구장비성능평가를 위하여 요청하는 자료
rows.text_en: 4. Other data requested by the evaluation agency for research equipment performance evaluation

rows.source_ko: ② 평가기관은 제1항에 따라 제출된 서류의 보완이 필요한 경우 30일 이내의 기간을 정하여 보완을 요청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If the evaluation agency needs to supplement the documents submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1, it may request supplementation by setting a period of up to 30 days.

rows.source_ko: ③ 평가기관은 연구장비성능평가를 마친 날부터 15일 이내에 별지 제10호서식의 연구장비성능평가 결과서를 해당 연구사업자에게 발급해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The evaluation institution shall issue the research equipment performance evaluation results report in the form of Annex 10 to the relevant research business operator within 15 days from the date the research equipment performance evaluation is completed.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에서 정한 사항 외에 연구장비성능평가의 방법ㆍ절차ㆍ기준 등에 관한 세부 사항은 과학기술정보통신부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters specified in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters concerning the methods, procedures, standards, etc. of research equipment performance evaluation shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Science and ICT .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(평가기관의 지정 등) 영 제11조제2항에 따라 평가기관의 지정을 신청하려는 자는 별지 제11호서식의 연구장비 성능평가기관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation of Evaluation Institution, etc.) Any person who intends to apply for the designation of an evaluation institution pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Minister of Science and ICT the application for designation of a research equipment performance evaluation institution in the form of Annex 11, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.
1. Articles of Incorporation
2. General Status of the Agency (Form No. 12)
3. Research Equipment Performance Evaluation Work Plan ( Form No. 13)

rows.source_ko: 4. 별지 제14호서식의 기관의 조직 및 인력 현황
rows.text_en: 4. Status of organization and personnel of the institution as per Form No. 14

rows.source_ko: 5. 별지 제15호서식의 기관의 사무ㆍ시험 공간 및 설비 현황
rows.text_en: 5. Status of the institution's office and testing spaces and facilities as per Form No. 15

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 영 제11조제2항제5호의 요건을 갖추었음을 확인하기 위하여 과학기술정보통신부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 서류
rows.text_en: 6. Other documents that the Minister of Science and ICT deems necessary to confirm that the requirements of Article 11, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree have been met
